# Sales Autonomy

> Sales Autonomy (https://salesautonomy.com) gives B2B sales reps, RevOps teams, and AI agents full autonomy to research verified buyer signals from public government filings. We watch federal, state, and city filings daily—truck insurance cancellations, OSHA safety inspections, clinic expansions, building permits, and expiring government contracts—and deliver verified decision-makers with direct proof links.

## Industries We Cover

1. **Healthcare & Multi-Site Clinics**
   - Multi-location medical, dental, and nursing groups expanding locations, switching patient booking software (Athenahealth, ModMed, Dentrix), or facing 45-day Medicare inspection correction deadlines.
   - Decision-makers: Clinic Owner, Managing Partner, COO, CFO.

2. **Trucking, Fleets & Factories**
   - Commercial fleets (15–500+ trucks; 1-truck operators filtered out) facing 30-day insurance cancellation notices or 60-day annual policy renewals, plus manufacturing plants hit with newly opened federal OSHA inspections or EPA compliance schedules.
   - Decision-makers: CFO, VP of Fleet Safety, VP of HR & Risk, VP of Plant Operations.

3. **Gov Contractors & Commercial Builders**
   - Federal contractors with bidding registrations expiring in 30, 60, or 90 days, active government contracts entering re-bid, and builders pulling $100K+ commercial permits (matched from project LLCs back to the real parent company).
   - Decision-makers: VP of Contracts, VP of Preconstruction & Procurement, CISO, CFO.

## Plans & Pricing

- **7-Day Territory Pilot ($1,950 one-time · 100% credited toward upgrade):** Match your current CRM account list against 1 industry. Includes 2,500 target accounts, 5,000 verified executive emails (<2% bounce guarantee), active 30/60/90-day deadlines, and a Missing Accounts Report.
- **Self-Serve Portal & API ($799/mo, billed quarterly):** Live search across 1 industry, 1,250 company unlocks/month (~2,500 verified buyers), weekly Monday CSV digest, webhooks, and REST/MCP API access.
- **Managed CRM Sync ($9,500 setup [$7,550 after Pilot credit] + $1,950/mo):** Full national industry synced directly into HubSpot, Salesforce, or Clay; 3,500 company unlocks/month (~7,000 verified buyers); weekly rep routing; monthly contact refresh; never overwrites rep notes.
- **Enterprise — All 3 Industries ($18,000 setup [$16,050 after Pilot credit] + $3,950/mo):** All 3 industries unlocked, direct Snowflake/BigQuery/Postgres warehouse sync, 10,000 company unlocks/month, human QA, custom DPA, and 99.5% uptime SLA.
- **Territory Protection:** Maximum 5 active subscribers per industry and regional territory.

## Accuracy Guarantees

- **Official records always beat web scrapes:** Federal and state filings outrank web directories and can never be overwritten by lower-trust scrapes.
- **Real executives only:** Outside accountants, tax preparers, lawyers, and registered agents are filtered out before delivery.
- **<2% email bounce guarantee:** Work emails are verified live on unlock, backed by 2-for-1 credit replacement.
- **Direct proof on every fact:** Every key field links straight back to the public government record.

## Delivery & Developer Access

- Weekly Monday CSV digests
- Live search portal
- Direct CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay)
- REST & MCP JSON-RPC API at `https://salesautonomy.com/api/vault`
